Long term (monthly): up since April; November is a pullback, and price is in the top of April's monthly gap (25,208–27,408).
Short term (weekly, daily): down. This week has given back most of last week's rally; Monday was a strong down day (76% body).

London: took yesterday's low (27,148.7), three equal lows at 27,143–27,149 and the overnight low, down to 27,001.8. Then the 06:00 hour reversed hard (83% body, 27,115 → 27,358) and closed back through the 02:00 sell block.

Where price is now (27,318): on the underside of the old 5 Nov daily gap (27,319–27,495) and the bottom of Monday's 4h bearish gap (27,316.6–27,400.6). On 4h candles that gap has only one body inside so far. The 4h candle closing at 10:00 decides: body inside = the gap is weaker.

Liquidity. Swept: the sellside under Monday's lows. Resting above: 27,382 (06:40), the Asia high 27,414, then the 4h gap 27,533.5–27,630.6. Resting below: the 06:00 hour's gap 27,137.8–27,288.7, then the London low 27,001.8.
Sell = with the weekly and daily: highs taken into the old gap and rejected (4h wicks, no 4h body inside), then a block. Targets 27,288.7, 27,137.8, 27,001.8.
Buy = with the monthly, against the daily: the 06:00 hour's gap holds on a retrace (hourly bodies stay out of its lower half). Targets 27,414, then 27,533.5–27,630.6.
Pace: one aggressive hour (06:00), slow since 07:00. No scheduled US release today.

The block: the 07:00 hourly candle (47.68–47.73, 12% body: dim), engulfed by the 08:00 hour.
The BOS level 47.26 (yours, 15m): traded under at 08:35–08:40 (47.22) but no 15m candle has closed below it. On its own timeframe it is not broken yet.
The retrace: 09:10 went up into the 15m gap left by the drop (47.55–47.62) and touched the bottom of the dim block at 47.68, to the cent, then turned. Price 47.53.
Sell = with the monthly, weekly and daily. What confirms: a 15m close under 47.26. Then 46.80 and 46.53. What cancels: a 4h body inside the gap, or the 47.93 high taken.
